answer: A recurring rent charges every identity 10 units at each tide, one tide per epoch, drawn from its own earned balance, and the payment cannot be shared, so an operator who tries to forge a hundred fakes must fund a hundred separate rents. An identity that misses a payment loses all weight until it pays double, and weight is measured over a 30-epoch horizon: a newcomer earns nothing until it has paid 30 rents in a row.
